subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: Should maintainers wait for a failed current-main proxy request/response capture before choosing between another sanitizer, better diagnostics/docs, or a strict-minimal completions mode?
rationale: The source path is plausible but the exact incompatible field is unknown; choosing a new mode or config surface without the captured payload could widen the provider contract unnecessarily.

options.title: Require proxy capture first
options.body: Ask for a redacted OpenClaw-generated request body plus proxy status/response, then implement only the proven compatibility or diagnostic gap.

options.title: Sponsor strict-minimal mode now
options.body: A maintainer can choose to add an explicit minimal proxy mode before capture, accepting new config/product surface to support narrow proxies.

options.title: Close after reporter confirmation
options.body: If the reporter confirms current main succeeds through the same proxy, close this as covered by the existing hardenings.

recommendation.title: Require proxy capture first
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted OpenClaw-generated request body plus proxy status/response, then implement only the proven compatibility or diagnostic gap.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the live assignee on this issue and is best positioned to decide what proof is enough for the remaining provider-fallback behavior.
